findings.title: A fixed-period certificate is released only when the stated period and the timestamps agree

cases.case: timestamps agree with the stated 1 ms period

result.estimates_line: Estimates: 1001 samples; last value of the target = 0.879812

cases.case: data recorded every 2 ms (every second sample kept), request states 1 ms

result.first_line: The timestamps of the data do not match the stated sample period; nothing is released.

cases.case: one sample missing (a 2 ms gap at t = 0.5 s)

result.first_line: The data are not sampled at a fixed period; no fixed-period certificate applies.

findings.title: Samples used to establish or disprove a requirement lie inside the requested window

cases.case: Kalman filter, record ends at t = 3.5 s (samples t = 0..3 s), mean-square-error level 0.616808

result.display: Verified design released.
result.claim: mean-square error of the target at every sample from t = 0 s to the last sample of the record, t = 3 s is at most 0.615895 <= 0.616808

cases.case: observer, velocity error <= 0.075 rad/s on the record from 0.05 s to its end at 0.06 s

result.display: Verified design released.
result.claim: |error| <= 0.0566298 at every sample instant from t = 0.05 s to t = 0.06 s for every admissible initial error, measurement error and disturbance

cases.case: 100 Hz encoder, requirement on t in [0.01 s, 0.0165 s]; the two-signal argument needs a sample at or after 0.01633 s

result.display: No verified design found.
result.explanation: high_gain_observer: no gain of the pole-matched sampled observer family meets the requirement (best bound found 0.260927 > 0.04); this is the limit of this certificate family, not a proof that no estimator can meet it

findings.title: Kalman filter start-up: estimate, exported covariance and explanation agree

cases.case: scalar random walk, Q = R = 1, P0 = 100, constant (steady-state) gain

result.display: Verified design released.
result.claim: constant (steady-state) Kalman gain: in the limit k -> infinity its error covariance equals that of the optimal filter, whose estimate is the conditional mean of the state given the measurements and inputs; minimum mean-square error among all estimators measurable with respect to the same information (jointly Gaussian initial state and noises); at finite times the time-varying filter is better (horizon 'finite'); error variance of the target in steady state (the limit as k -> infinity): at most 0.618034; the exported covariance at each sample is that of the constant gain started from the stated initial covariance
result.uncertainty_type: error covariance (second-order statistic); not a deterministic error bound
result.covariance_basis: error covariance of the released gain sequence propagated from the stated initial covariance (exact for this estimate at every sample, including start-up)

findings.title: The decision uses all supplied constraints together

cases.case: total disturbance bound D = 6 and, for the exactly known model, additive bound d = 1.5; ultimate velocity limit 0.045 rad/s (two-signal limits 2 sqrt(DV) = 0.0490, 2 sqrt(dV) = 0.0245)

result.display: Verified design released.
result.claim: lim sup |error| <= 0.0290641 at the sample instants (an ultimate bound; no finite-time claim is made) for every admissible initial error, measurement error and disturbance

cases.case: smallest mean-square error of the speed; nominal input gain b = 4 but the true value lies in [3.6, 4.4]

result.display: No verified design found.
result.explanation: the plant is within the supported classes, but no method in the register provides the requested kind of claim for it

findings.title: A worst-case limit does not show that a probability requirement is impossible

cases.case: speed error within 0.04 rad/s with probability 0.9 (bounded noise; worst-case limit 2 sqrt(DV) = 0.049)

result.display: Verified design released.
result.claim: in steady state (the limit as k -> infinity), |error| <= 0.04 with probability at least 0.960368 (Chebyshev inequality with error variance P (distribution-free): P(|e| <= r) >= 1 - P / r^2); the statement is per time instant, not simultaneous over the window

cases.case: speed error within 0.02 rad/s with probability 0.9 (bounded noise; worst-case limit 2 sqrt(DV) = 0.049)

result.display: No verified design found.
result.explanation: kalman_filter: the provable level 0.841473 is below the requested 0.900000 (Chebyshev inequality with error variance P (distribution-free): P(|e| <= r) >= 1 - P / r^2)

findings.title: Worst-case envelope with initialisation from the first encoder reading

cases.case: servo axis, velocity estimate initialised from the first reading (position) and zero (velocity)

result.claim: |error| <= 0.0566298 at every sample instant t_k >= 0.05 s for every admissible initial error, measurement error and disturbance
